regressions.issue: The new `{32,256}` cap creates a narrow new bypass: a contiguous base58 run of >=257 chars surrounded by non-base58 boundaries is NOT redacted (sanitize('A'*257) returns input unchanged). Look-around requires the run to be flanked by non-base58 chars; the regex engine then refuses to match because the inner span exceeds 256. Practical impact: any single base58 token longer than 256 chars (e.g. concatenated multi-keypair dumps, large base58-encoded blobs) leaks. Real Solana pubkeys are 32-44 chars and keypairs 87-88, so this only matters for deliberately adversarial inputs or pathological log lines. Mitigation: replace `{32,256}` with two alternatives `{32,256}|{257,}` or remove the cap and rely on whitespace anchors. Severity is minor because the original {32,44} bypass class is now closed and the remaining cap bypass requires uncommon payload shapes.

remaining_observations: Documented over-redaction: `ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-opus-4-5` (digit in value) still redacts whole assignment. Acceptable per spec.
JWK single-letter field names (`x`,`y`,`d`) can collide with non-JWK JSON; unchanged from Round 1, by design.
ReDoS perf measured: 1MB random ANTHROPIC_-prefixed line sanitized in ~25ms (acceptable).
